paragraphs: The University of Dundee is a public research university located in the city of Dundee on the east coast of Scotland. Founded in 1881 as University College Dundee and gaining independent university status in 1967, the university has a worldwide reputation in life sciences (top-10 UK), dentistry (top-rated in UK), medicine, and Duncan of Jordanstone College of Art and Design (DJCAD). The compact city-centre campus sits between Dundee city centre and the River Tay.

International students enter via the Oxford International pathway programmes at Dundee — International Foundation, International Year One, and Pre-Master courses lead directly into Dundee Bachelor and Master degrees.
paragraphsRu: University of Dundee — государственный исследовательский университет в Данди на восточном побережье Шотландии. Основан в 1881 году. Мировая репутация в life sciences (топ-10 UK), стоматологии (#1 в UK), медицине, и Duncan of Jordanstone College of Art and Design (DJCAD). Компактный city-centre кампус между центром города и рекой Тей.
Международные студенты заходят через pathway-программы Oxford International в Dundee — International Foundation, International Year One и Pre-Master ведут в бакалавриат / магистратуру Dundee.
